## Public security fix / catalog change

- [ ] The vulnerability and fix have been **publicly disclosed**.
- [ ] I linked the primary vendor advisory or upstream maintainer source.
- [ ] I identified exact product, branch, platform, edition and affected range.
- [ ] I supplied exact vendor fixed release/commit, or marked the mapping unresolved.
- [ ] I preserved original upstream attribution and license for any source patch.
- [ ] I provided version + running-state validation and a benign smoke test.
- [ ] No live exploit, proprietary binary patch, credentials, or private data included.
- [ ] `python scripts/catalog.py validate` passed.
- [ ] `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v` passed.
